facts.text: Product: Duropedic Airboost 6.8 Arctic Ice Mattress.
Selected variant: Queen, 78 × 60 in (198 × 152 cm), 8 in (20.3 cm) high.
The product title specifies Airknit fibres with latex.
The mattress has a 6-inch Airboost layer combined with latex.
The reversible latex topper offers firm support on one side and medium-firm support on the other; flip the mattress to switch firmness levels.
The zipper cover is machine washable; softer wash settings are recommended to increase durability.
Airboost is described as using over one lakh independently responsive fibres, designed to improve airflow, movement response and postural support.
